methods.description: Verify immutable source/API byte receipts and exact identities; project unchanged OGC CRS84 geometries into ETRS89 / UTM zone 29N (EPSG:25829), then use direct GEOS union/intersection/difference/boundary operations for area and linear-contact measurements. Inputs are not repaired, snapped, buffered, filled, clipped, or assigned by proximity.
methods.units: metres and square metres; OGC:CRS84 coordinates longitude/latitude
methods.crs: Input OGC:CRS84; measurement EPSG:25829 (ETRS89 / UTM zone 29N)
methods.area_method: Direct GEOS planar area in EPSG:25829; coverage is intersection with the unmodified gap polygon, and residual is gap difference from the unchanged union.
methods.distance_method: Direct GEOS distance, boundary-contact line length, and Hausdorff distance in EPSG:25829; no nearest-owner assignment.

conclusions.text: The pinned importer hashes complete simplified geoBoundaries files; those exact Spain and Portugal simplified bytes are restored and verified independently from their distinct complete raw objects.

All 55 exact Spain source members for the three Atlas districts are present in both complete 2018 ADM3 source files. Eight dated IGN border-line names uniquely match eight distinct members inside that exact 55-member roster.

The eight selected IGN line records have complete current administrativeunit polygon items: seven exact-name matches and Zarza la Mayor resolved by the exact nationalcode prefix carried by its full line item. This native-code crosswalk is source-supported; the collection does not state polygon validity date, and no published cross-provider ID crosswalk to the Portuguese municipalities is established.

The four Portugal Atlas municipalities match direct full CAOP2025 item features by exact DTMN code/name. CAOP collection title is 2025 while declared temporal extent is 2000–2007, retained as a vintage limitation.

The union of eight current IGN Spanish municipality polygons and four direct CAOP2025 Portuguese municipality polygons covers 99.9909% of the exact pinned full gap (297,501,253.047717 m2); the complete uncovered 27,087.655736 m2 MultiPolygon residual coordinates are preserved in EPSG:25829 in the final reports for later partition/classification. This is a modern administrative-reference comparison, not a seam repair or ownership allocation.

The eight IGN lines total 124,601.889222 m, with 39,039.008346 m inside the gap and zero linear contact length with the gap polygon boundary; line contacts are measured separately from polygon area coverage.

The exact bilateral instrument/registered international coordinates and jointly authoritative cross-provider administrative crosswalk remain unverified. The country-level Spain–Portugal legalstatus is unpopulated, so item-level agreed status is not a legal certification. Physical water/shoreline position, seasonal movement, datum/registration history, and limited-AOI implications have no dated source in this packet. No core map edit, delivery, or geographic approval is claimed.
